{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for drawing more American oil from American soil to achieve energy independence.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for accelerated exploration, drilling, and development in America, including off the nation's coasts, and in Montana, North Dakota, and Alaska.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Green River Basin in Colorado, Utah, and Wyoming offers recoverable shale oil that is ready for development, and most of it is on federal lands.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for expanding refining capacity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"No new refinery has been built in this country in 30 years because of environmental extremism and regulatory blockades in Washington.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for encouraging refinery construction and modernization and an expedited permitting process, with sensitivity to environmental concerns.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to any protracted legal challenges that could unreasonably delay or preclude actual production from increased domestic exploration, drilling, and production.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to efforts that would permanently block access to the coastal plain of the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
